pages.text: $(li)Line 0: a PROGRAM block at x=5, then a LABEL named $(1)first$().$(li)Line 1: a NOOP block at x=5. Every program needs it here.$(li)Line 2: another NOOP. A FUNCTION always needs a NOOP line right above it.$(li)Line 3: a FUNCTION block at x=5, then a LABEL named $(1)answer$().

$(li)Line 4: a RESULT block at x=6, a LABEL named $(1)result$() and an INTEGER type block.$(li)Line 5: a BEGIN block at x=5.$(li)Line 6: an ASSIGN block at x=6, a LABEL $(1)result$(), a LITERAL 42 and an OPERATOR $(1);$().$(li)Line 7: an END block at x=5, followed by a FUNCTION block.
When all line numbers are dark green or faint, the program is ready. Leave the line after the END empty. The first empty line ends the program.
